registers.label: Spare
lines: The angel comes to a girl in Nazareth with impossible news.
Nothing will be impossible with God.
A virgin shall conceive and bear a son.
And they shall call his name Emmanuel, God with us.
Mary said yes, and the Word took flesh.
Let it be to us according to your word. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Into an ordinary room in a forgotten town, the angel's light falls across a young woman's face.
Let it be to me according to your word.
Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God. The child you bear will be holy, the Son of the Most High.
Let it be to me according to your word.
For nothing — not a barren womb, not a virgin's wonder, not the long silence of Israel — nothing is impossible with God.
Let it be to me according to your word.
A body God has prepared, and Mary opens her life to carry it. Come, let us worship the Word made flesh.
Let it be to me according to your word. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The angel comes to Nazareth with light and impossible news.
Here am I, the servant of the Lord.
A virgin will conceive; his name shall be Emmanuel.
Here am I, the servant of the Lord.
The Word takes flesh; come, let us worship.
Here am I, the servant of the Lord. Amen.
